The Karthigai Deepam was lit at the traditional spot despite court orders, sparking fresh protests in the state. Watch Episode 1771, where ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta explains the row over lighting a lamp on a Madurai hilltop, its origin, legalities & politics around it.
The Episode was first published on 13 December 2025.
